About Saanjh

Made with care. Served with love.

Saanjh, which means evening in Hindi, brings people together through fresh, flavourful Indian food. Every dish is prepared using quality ingredients and recipes that make every visit memorable.

Whether you come for a quick lunch, family dinner, or special celebration, there is always a warm table waiting for you.
